hook: Your church here sits inside a pit.
title: Eleven Churches Carved Down Into the Ground
description:
In Lalibela, Ethiopia, eleven churches were carved downward out of solid rock. Each one sits in a pit with its roof level with the ground, and people still pray in them today. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #PlacesThatShouldntExist #Ethiopia
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
